objective: Select the next validation goal after closing the TL-UL/template metadata-invariant public-pack boundary.

decision.reason: The generated-config path now has breadth, shape breadth, additional targets, and representative metadata-invariant execution evidence. The next useful gap is not another correctness run; it is to define the smallest user-facing surface that moves from template-driven sidecar operation toward a Verilator-like hybrid entrypoint without claiming a Verilator-native option or changing runtime/ABI behavior yet.

candidate_review.name: verilator_like_hybrid_entrypoint_option_surface
candidate_review.reason: It directly addresses the project goal of making hybrid execution as simple as a normal Verilator invocation while preserving the small active surface.

candidate_review.name: more_template_metadata_invariant_breadth
candidate_review.reason: More representative templates can add confidence, but the current six-template set already covers the main metadata forms and further breadth would mostly increase evidence volume.

candidate_review.name: resident_execution_optimization
candidate_review.reason: Runtime tuning should wait until the user-facing entrypoint boundary is explicit.

candidate_review.name: quantized_kv_cache_boundary
candidate_review.reason: Quantized KV-cache remains a later workload boundary, not the next usability gap.

candidate_review.name: larger_shape_or_repeat_median_timing
candidate_review.reason: Timing evidence should not be mixed into the current packaging and entrypoint-surface transition.

required_next_gate.name: define_verilator_like_hybrid_entrypoint_option_surface_gate
must_pin: which CLI surface is the intended bridge toward a future Verilator option
whether the input is a filelist/template/target name at this stage
how automatic GPU allocation shape selection is represented without hiding the policy
which existing templates are allowed as the first supported surface
generated reports and artifacts remain non-canonical
explicit non-claim that Verilator itself has a native option in this repository

non_claims: not a new runtime or ABI change
not approval to import untracked candidate overlays
not universal validation for every historical template
reports and artifacts are generated evidence, not source of truth
